title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
title_zh: 强大智能体需要多复杂的 Harness 才能实现自主机器学习工程？
abstract_en: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，自主机器学习工程（autonomous machine learning engineering，MLE）智能体在公开排行榜上取得了显著进展。由于长期迭代中的性能停滞以及大语言模型（LLM）原语有限，现代 MLE 智能体通常依赖日益复杂的系统架构，包括多智能体编排器、专用检索子智能体等。然而，对于更基础但能力不断增强的 coding agent，尤其是能够通过 read、write 和 bash 原语直接访问执行环境的智能体，相关研究仍然不足。本文发现，在相同时间预算和相同前沿 LLM backbone 下，开源最先进的 harness 相较于仅使用单会话 minimal-harness coding agent 基线并未带来优势，性能提升主要由 backbone 驱动。通过大规模、系统性的消融实验，作者指出，在 coding agent 场景中，额外的机器层级往往是冗余的。论文最终认为，围绕强大模型构建复杂手工 harness，在当前 MLE benchmark 上的投入回报较低。
key_points_zh: 在相同时间预算和 LLM backbone 下，复杂开源 harness 未优于单会话 minimal-harness coding agent。
性能的主要来源是底层 LLM backbone，而非多智能体编排、检索子智能体等额外组件。
大规模消融实验表明，coding agent 具备 read、write、bash 等基础原语后，许多 machinery layers 会变得冗余。
围绕强模型持续堆叠手工设计的 harness，在当前自主 MLE benchmark 上收益有限。
研究结论提示，未来应更多关注提升 backbone 能力，而非一味增加系统架构复杂度。

llm_assessment.comment: This systematic study provides an important negative result about when elaborate orchestration fails to outperform a minimal coding-agent harness.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该系统研究给出了重要的负面结论，说明复杂编排何时无法优于最小化编码智能体框架。
